    • create

      @PostMapping(produces="application/json") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Transaction> create(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid Transaction entity) throws Exception
      Creates a transaction through the generic mapping inherited from UpdateCreate, enforcing the lifetime per-tenant transaction limit that the specialised endpoints below already enforce.

      Neither of the generic guards reaches this entity: Transaction is a TenantBaseID, so createEntity skips the daily CUD check, and LimitKeyConfig.KEY_TRANSACTION is registered with checkedOnGenericCreate = false so that the specialised call sites can raise the specific translated message instead of a bare LIMIT_SECURITY_BREACH. Without this override the generic mapping would grow the transaction table without any cap.

      This also covers a PUT carrying no id: UpdateCreate.updateEntity delegates such a request to create, which is this method.

      Overrides:
      create in class UpdateCreate<Transaction>
      Throws:
